Emily (Docs): Opened PR to update the model card for aether-7b — adds compatibility notes for quantized variants, example SDK streaming snippet, and revised throughput/limits section.
Emily (Docs): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/623 :eyes: 
Raj (DevEx): +1. Can you add a brief migration note for customers using the old streaming endpoint? A one-paragraph snippet should do.
Emily (Docs): Yep — added a "Migration" subsection at the bottom. It shows old -> new SDK call mapping.
Michael (Eng-ML): Quick check: the quantized compatibility table says q4_k_m works with KV caching off. That's correct for now, right? We still see corruption when KV cache is used with that quant config.
Sophia (Eng-Platform): Confirmed — q4_k_m + KV cache is flaky on current runtime. We expose a compat note recommending "disable kv_cache" and link to the runtime issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/391
Emily (Docs): Added that link and a small example toggling kv_cache. Also included our benchmark numbers. Pls sanity-check the numbers.
Michael (Eng-ML): Numbers look ok but update the latency row to clarify p50/p95 are per-token after warmup. Also replace "A100" with "NVIDIA A100 40GB" for clarity.
Emily (Docs): Done.
Katie (Product): Customer-facing wording: can we soften "not supported" to "not recommended" for q4_k_m + kv_cache? Product wants to avoid hard "unsupported" language unless it's an SLA/SEC issue.
Sophia (Eng-Platform): Good call. It's a runtime instability rather than policy. Changed to "not recommended".
Raj (DevEx): SDK snippet looks good but uses old import path. Updated to the new SDK v2 import and streaming helper.
Emily (Docs): Here's the final streaming snippet I added — can someone glance for correctness?
Emily (Docs): ```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")

with client.responses.stream(model="aether-7b", max_tokens=256, kv_cache=False) as stream:
    stream.send("Generate a short product blurb about low-latency inference.")
    for chunk in stream.iter_text():
        print(chunk, end="")
```
Michael (Eng-ML): Looks good. Note: call uses `kv_cache=False` which matches the compat note. Maybe add a comment above showing how to enable token-level tracing: `client.enable_tracing()`
Emily (Docs): Added a one-line comment for tracing.
ci-bot: Build check passed for docs PR #623 — link: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/9234
docs-bot: Spelling check: minor suggestion — change "throughput/limits" header to "throughput and limits" for readability.
Emily (Docs): Fixed that header and pushed one more commit.
Katie (Product): LGTM from product. Can we schedule a small announcement in #announcements after merge? I'll draft copy.
Sophia (Eng-Platform): One more todo: add a short note in Dedicated docs about reserved-capacity tuning for aether-7b; I'll open a follow-up PR.
Emily (Docs): Thanks everyone — merging once CI finishes. If anything else comes up, please post here and I'll follow up.
